text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, a wedding ceremony is being held at 
Tracen Academy. The star of the day is an 
alumna of the academy. And the organizer 
of the ceremony is, of course—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! The weather today is super nice 
too! Welcome, welcome~!

text_block_list.name: Alumnae Guests
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, the smell of turf brings back 
memories! —...Wait, why are we lining up 
here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's because~ We're holding today's main 
race right here!!
choice_data_list: A main race... at a wedding?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLANG!! Gates open!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The Wedding Stakes! Turf 1400m! All 
runners are off to a clean start!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the lead is the bride! Sprinting 
through the memorable distance of her 
debut race, she now enters the stage of 
her new life!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, hah, hah...! Ahaha... this scenery 
brings back so many memories...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful entrance by the stars 
of the day! ...But wait, there's even 
more~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, please direct your 
attention to the big screen over there!

Ready, set, CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR 
WEDDIIIIING!!!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
Those cheering banners! N-No way... are 
those people—

text_block_list.name: Fans of Alumna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all the thrills and 
happiness you gave us! Now, it's your turn 
to be happy~~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
To kick off the reception, we'll start 
with a mini-live performed by the bride 
and her friends!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's hype everyone up with songs! Raise 
your voices, dance, and get excited!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking center stage today! Is 
everybody ready!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the wedding designed by Haru 
Urara continued to delight the crowd of 
attendees...

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: —And now, a few words from the bride!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! This is the finale! I hope she 
isn't too nervous!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for coming today. Being able 
to start anew right here, where I chased 
my dreams... has made me so truly happy!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
And... there's someone here I would like 
to introduce. The one who put together 
such a wonderful wedding for us—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text: Our Muse, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whaaat! Me!?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of running a race, the precious 
times spent with those I hold dear... you 
helped me remember all those sparkling 
days.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan! Thank you so much for giving 
us such a wonderful, thrilling wedding...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Big sister...! Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...You know! At first, I had no clue what 
to do for a "wonderful wedding."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I thought and thought so much that 
everything got all jumbled up in my head~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But... the Muses reminded me! About what 
you asked for back then, miss!

text_block_list.name: Alumna Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Right! Seeing Urara-chan working so hard 
as a Muse to bring excitement, I realized 
something.

text_block_list.name: Alumna Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
If you could lend a hand, it would 
definitely become a wonderful new 
beginning!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When I heard your story, I didn't just 
think about throwing a super huge party.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanted both of you to feel super 
excited!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to tell you that every day from 
now on will be exciting, and that there's 
so much to look forward to! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
May your new journey together be filled 
with endless excitement! Here is a present 
from Urara!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the wedding— While 
walking through the academy, I spotted 
Haru Urara reading a letter out loud with 
a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, every day is full of excitement! 
May thrilling days await you in the future 
too, Urara-chan."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The future, huh~! I wonder what it'll be 
like? Hmm, I don't really know yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Forever and ever! Even when I become an 
old grandma, I wanna have loooots and lots 
of excitement!
